description: This file contains React functional components for UI elements such as Card, Button, Input, Badge, and others, designed for a web application's frontend. It provides reusable components with styling and props to customize behavior and appearance.

methods.name: Card
methods.description: A styled container component for grouping content with a rounded border and shadow.

methods.name: CardHeader
methods.description: Component for rendering a header section within a card, with title, subtitle, and optional right-aligned content.

methods.name: CardBody
methods.description: Component for rendering the main body/content area within a card.

methods.name: Button
methods.description: A customizable button component supporting different variants like primary, secondary, danger, and ghost, with styling and disabled states.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: A styled input component with label, hint, and error message display capabilities.

methods.name: Textarea
methods.description: A styled textarea component with label, hint, and error message display.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: A styled select dropdown component with label, hint, and error message.

methods.name: Badge
methods.description: A small badge component with tone options for different statuses or categories.

methods.name: SeverityBadge
methods.description: A badge indicating defect severity, with color coding based on severity level.

methods.name: StatusBadge
methods.description: A badge indicating defect status, with color coding based on status value.

methods.name: Divider
methods.description: A horizontal line used as a visual separator.

methods.name: InlineSpinner
methods.description: A small inline loading spinner component with optional label.
